The classes a `class` property can carry, grouped the way they are registered. A class written here
with `-*` takes a value after the dash.

Values come in three spellings:

- **a named one**, which is what tailwind calls a scale: `p-4`, `text-sm`, `rounded-lg`, `bg-sky-500`
- **a bare number**, read as spacing units of 4 gui pixels: `p-4` is 16 pixels of padding
- **an arbitrary one in square brackets**, read as written: `w-[120px]`, `bg-[#ff00aa]`, `grid-cols-[1fr_auto]`

A colour takes an optional alpha after a slash, as `bg-slate-900/70`, and the palette is in the
[colours reference](/ctml/reference/colors). A class can be written behind one or more
[variants](/ctml/reference/variants), as `md:hover:bg-sky-500` is.

A class the parser cannot use is handed back rather than quietly dropped, so a typo is something your
host can report.

## The words a size can say

A class that takes a length reads a bare number as spacing units, and these words instead:

- `px`: one gui pixel
- `auto`: whatever is left over
- `full`: all of the parent
- `screen`: the whole window height
- `svw`, `lvw`, `dvw`: the whole window width
- `svh`, `lvh`, `dvh`: the whole window height

`w-screen` is the window's width and `h-screen` its height, the one being swapped for the other on
the horizontal axis. A fraction is a percentage, so `w-1/2` is half the parent. `min`, `max` and
`fit` are css's `min-content`, `max-content` and `fit-content`. Inside square brackets the value is
read as css writes it: `px`, `%`, `vw` and `vh` all work, and a bare number there is pixels rather
than spacing units.

## The named scales

Three classes take a word out of a scale of their own rather than a length. Each also takes a plain
value, as `text-[11px]`, `rounded-3` and `tracking-[2px]` do.

### `text-*`

| Written | Pixels |
| --- | --- |
| `text-xs` | 12 |
| `text-sm` | 14 |
| `text-base` | 16 |
| `text-lg` | 18 |
| `text-xl` | 20 |
| `text-2xl` | 24 |
| `text-3xl` | 30 |
| `text-4xl` | 36 |

### `rounded-*`

| Written | Pixels |
| --- | --- |
| `rounded-none` | 0 |
| `rounded-sm` | 2 |
| `rounded-md` | 6 |
| `rounded-lg` | 8 |
| `rounded-xl` | 12 |
| `rounded-2xl` | 16 |
| `rounded-3xl` | 24 |
| `rounded-full` | 9999 |

### `tracking-*`

| Written | Pixels |
| --- | --- |
| `tracking-tighter` | -1 |
| `tracking-tight` | 0 |
| `tracking-normal` | 0 |
| `tracking-wide` | 1 |
| `tracking-wider` | 2 |
| `tracking-widest` | 3 |
